verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document at https://amplitude.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so the spec is directly downloadable. The docs also describe a broad REST surface it could plausibly cover: HTTP V2 ingestion, export, cohorts, dashboard, taxonomy and Experiment APIs. missing for 10: first-party documentation that describes or links the spec, and evidence of how much of the documented API surface it covers (version, completeness, independent corroboration).
